$Comment: Christmas, the winter season after Harvest Feast. The file name is the event id: every Season leaf,
spawn rule and page in the pack names it Christmas. Both days of the Window are in it, counted in
UTC because no Clock is written, so Christmas runs from the first moment of December 2nd to the last
moment of January 10th. Its End falls before its Start, so a run crosses the new year and belongs to
the year it starts in: the run that opens on December 2nd 2026 is the 2026 run. Its first days
overlap the end of Harvest Feast, which runs to December 6th; Christmas Morning
A file that must vanish while Christmas is off writes Season: Christmas, on itself or on the base it
inherits from. A conversation line reads ziggfreedcommon:feature with Param Christmas_Live and Min 1
instead, and a roll or a lock reads ziggfreedcommon:calendar_live with Param Christmas.
Presentation names the season wherever events are listed, with the game's red Christmas packet as
its picture. Herald is the banner: Start shows once to each player, the first time they are on the
server during a run; End shows to everyone online when a run ends by its dates or by a command, and
never when the event is switched off.
A server owner switches Christmas off, or moves its days, in mods/ziggfreedcommon/calendar.json
without touching this file. /zigcalendar status Christmas shows what the server reads.
